properties.description: The agent that signed in to flo2.io as OAuth client https://claude.ai/oauth/mcp-oauth-client-metadata (the sign-in token names it, and flo2 checks the token), calling itself "Claude-User" in its requests (its own word, not checked). flo2.io records it as the agent a change went through, beside the signed-in person it was for: attribution only, never an approval.
properties.name: Claude-User
